query: 社会影响评估 社会影响评估 衡量企业识别、分析、管理及监测其运营和特定项目（正负面）社会后果的能力。重点考察评估方法的科学性、负面风险分级、缓释计划的有效性及项目后的影响评估。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的社会影响评估框架（SIA）；在项目立项前执行正式的风险分级；针对识别的负面影响（如搬迁、生计破坏）制定了详细的缓释计划；且披露了项目实施后的社会成效审计或后评估。 • 1分（合格）：在重大项目实施中包含基础的社会风险调查或可行性研究，具备定性的影响描述和初步的补偿/缓解措施，但缺乏标准化的评估方法论或系统的后评估追踪。 • 0分（不合格）：无社会影响评估相关披露，或仅关注经济/环境评估而忽略社会维度。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：社会影响评估机制覆盖 >80% 的重大投资项目、新建工程、并购活动或高风险运营区域。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对法律强制要求的项目执行，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 社会影响评估 社会风险评估 搬迁安置 生计恢复 人权影响评估 项目后评估 社会风险尽职调查 缓释计划 SIA HRIA social impact assessment SIA social risk assessment resettlement plan livelihood restoration human rights impact assessment post-evaluation project social due diligence HRIA 是否有正式社会影响评估（SIA）框架或方法？ 重大项目立项前是否做社会风险分级？ 对搬迁、生计破坏等负面影响的缓释计划是什么？ 是否开展项目后社会成效审计或后评估？ 机制覆盖多少重大投资、新建或并购项目？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '社会影响评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式社会影响评估（SIA）框架或方法？ 重大项目立项前是否做社会风险分级？ 对搬迁、生计破坏等负面影响的缓释计划是什么？ 是否开展项目后社会成效审计或后评估？ 机制覆盖多少重大投资、新建或并购项目？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有环评而忽略社会维度；仅有社区公益捐赠；仅有社区参与活动报道；仅有人权政策口号而无项目评估；区分：社会影响评估针对运营/项目正负面影响的识别分级缓释与后评估；社区参与战略是日常社区关系框架；实质性评估是公司级ESG议题排序。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Ju Teng International classifies all the suppliers into different levels (A/B/C/D) by the quality of the supplier's products and services and the degree of risk involved. Ju Teng International has conducted a risk assessment based on the risk items listed in the 'Supplier's Basic Information Table'. High-risk suppliers (scores below 80) are required to provide a rectification plan and make rectification, and if the rectification is not completed within the agreed period, the audit qualification of these suppliers will be cancelled. In addition, all Production Plants of Ju Teng International have introduced new procurement categories such as moulds, auxiliary materials, and equipment to strengthen centralised management of the procurement process.

RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION

[Content]
Ju Teng International classifies all the suppliers into different levels (A/B/C/D) by the quality of the supplier's products and services and the degree of risk involved. Ju Teng International has conducted a risk assessment based on the risk items listed in the 'Supplier's Basic Information Table'. High-risk suppliers (scores below 80) are required to provide a rectification plan and make rectification, and if the rectification is not completed within the agreed period, the audit qualification of these suppliers will be cancelled. In addition, all Production Plants of Ju Teng International have introduced new procurement categories such as moulds, auxiliary materials, and equipment to strengthen centralised management of the procurement process.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION / Energy management
results.text: Purchased electricity, natural gas and diesel are the main types of energy consumed by Ju Teng International in the course of production and operation. Ju Teng International has systematically strengthened the management of energy use through the 'Energy and Resource Management Procedure'. By adopting environmentally and socially friendly measures which are technically feasible and economically viable, we have actively updated our internal management regulations on energy use and mobilised all employees to save energy and reduce consumption. During the Reporting Period, the Compal Production Plant has adopted scientific methods to formulate production quota assessment and fully motivate the staff to save energy and reduce consumption through the combination of assessment and reward and punishment system. According to the load change and operation condition of the equipment, the characteristics of frequency conversion control technology are used to carry out energy-saving technical transformation of some equipment running at low load, which has achieved a power saving rate of about 30%. Meanwhile, all plants adopt green lighting to reduce energy consumption.
